name: Cadence
shortDescription: A UK church volunteer-rota product in private beta, designed to balance availability, recent serving history, rest and workload when building team rotas.
suitableContexts: UK churches willing to participate in a closely supported private beta
Ministry teams wanting rota suggestions that consider rest, availability and prior serving
Churches using another system for member data but needing a focused rota workflow

pricing.summary: Cadence states that its first eight UK private-beta churches receive access at no cost during beta. No post-beta pricing, contract term or renewal arrangement is published in the reviewed material; obtain these in writing before relying on the service.

tiers.label: Private beta
tiers.detail: Supplier says its first eight UK beta churches receive founder-led onboarding and no cost during beta.

gdprInformation: The reviewed public page links to a privacy policy for its waitlist form but does not establish the live product's DPA, hosting location, security controls, sub-processors, retention rules, access permissions, export process or deletion workflow. It says spreadsheet import is available. Do not load a complete member or sensitive pastoral dataset during a private beta without written data-processing and exit arrangements.
coreFeatures: Rota suggestions based on availability and serving history
integrations: Supplier says Cadence can be used alongside ChurchSuite, Planning Center or other systems; no direct integration is established in the reviewed material
importExport: Supplier says people can be imported from a spreadsheet
No public export format or account-closure process was found; obtain this before beta use
support: Supplier describes founder-led onboarding for beta churches
Contact route is published at support@churchcadence.com

uk-operator.value: Cadence identifies Vue Solutions Ltd in its footer. Companies House lists Vue Solutions Ltd (07772890) as active and registered in Croydon.

church-rota-workflow.value: Supplier describes a church-focused rota product that considers availability, recent serving history, rest, fairness, gaps and replacements.

beta-status.value: Supplier states that Cadence is in private beta for its first eight UK churches, with founder-led onboarding and no cost during beta.

editorial.assessment: Cadence is an early-stage, explicitly UK church-focused rota product with a distinctive aim: reduce uneven volunteer load by making rest, availability and serving history part of rota suggestions. Its public positioning is clear, but it remains a private beta rather than a proven general release. It can be a sensible discovery option for a church happy to co-shape the product, not a low-risk choice for a team that needs established integrations, contract terms or sensitive-data assurances today.
bestFor: UK churches that can trial an early product with a small, non-sensitive team
Rota coordinators concerned about fairness, fatigue and repeated over-allocation
Churches willing to retain their existing management system while testing a focused rota layer
strengths: Clear focus on rest, fairness and serving history
No-cost beta access for the initial cohort
limitations: Private beta, with the supplier initially onboarding only eight UK churches
No public post-beta price, terms, DPA, hosting, support commitment or exit process
No direct ChurchSuite or Planning Center integration is established by the reviewed material
Not presented as a member database, giving, safeguarding, pastoral-care or worship-planning system
Operator remains active at Companies House, but its latest confirmation statement is recorded as overdue; obtain current contracting details before entering an agreement

procurementVerdict.problem: Building fairer volunteer rotas while reducing over-serving and manual rota work
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A church-specific private-beta product that turns rest and serving history into rota-planning inputs
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask for the current beta agreement, DPA, hosting and export details; then run a small non-sensitive ministry rota alongside the current process and compare suggested assignments, gaps, overrides and coordinator time
